acceptance_claim: Recovery scheduling component evidence only; no assigned Stage 02 criterion is marked passed.

compiler_warnings: One test-local variable is never mutated; no production-source warning.

earlier_storage_evidence.note: Those implementations remain byte-identical; final selected run compiled the full current package and ran only the 36 new scheduling/composition cases. Do not represent this as one 95-test run.

composition: Close forces the newest unsaved revision into the real encrypted SQLite store; reopening recovers its exact BOM, CRLF and Unicode bytes while the saved source remains at the earlier revision.
An unavailable injected recovery key prevents durability acknowledgement but permits ordinary coordinated source saving; after key restoration, explicit retry restores recovery with the same source.
review_corrections: Revision zero is a real first revision, distinct from no durable revision.
Failed persistence pauses scheduling instead of spinning; a new edit restores the cleared scheduling anchor.
Close forces pending source and has a cancellable waiter; cancellation leaves an already-committing store write alone.
A failed or cancelled close permits continued editing; a concurrent close is refused and a completed close clears isClosing.
A failed timer clears its task/token and exposes schedulingFailed.
The oldest-pending clock advances after the preceding commit; continuous editing cannot postpone the deadline.
Injected intervals are scaled correctly and clamped to one second; source bounds and foreign recovery seeds are checked before retention.
Saved-file acknowledgements reflect completion order and reject mismatched bytes for the current revision.
limitations: Not attached to NSDocument, application lifecycle, native close/quit UI or Keychain; source is local unmerged preparation.
The 34 scheduler tests use a virtual clock. Actual SystemMonotonicScheduler timing, app latency and the one-second product acceptance bound remain NOT MEASURED.
A store delayed beyond the checkpoint interval exposes overdue state; scheduling alone cannot guarantee the device completed a durable write.
No real Keychain, sandbox grants, iCloud, Google Drive, full volume, physical power loss or Intel runtime measured.
Input bounds were tested with smaller injected limits; exact default 8 MiB / 1,000,000 scalar edge cases were not separately run for the coordinator.
Saved acknowledgements assume the caller reports real completion order; serialization of native saves remains the document-session owner responsibility.
Detailed private capture history and mutation receipts are not persisted by source recovery; no HWP authority or consent grant is created.
All Stage 01 external acceptance blockers and all later mandatory stages remain open.
